name: machine-pressure
description: Refuses a second e2e or docker run, and any heavy command while CPU, RAM, swap or disk pressure is RED, plus a statusline script you add by hand.

cpu_amber.title: CPU amber (%)
cpu_amber.description: CPU use in percent of all cores at which pressure turns AMBER.

cpu_red.title: CPU red (%)
cpu_red.description: CPU use in percent of all cores at which pressure turns RED.

ram_amber.title: RAM amber (%)
ram_amber.description: RAM in use (not available) in percent at which pressure turns AMBER.

ram_red.title: RAM red (%)
ram_red.description: RAM in use in percent at which pressure turns RED.

swap_amber.title: Swap amber (%)
swap_amber.description: Swap in use in percent at which pressure turns AMBER.

swap_red.title: Swap red (%)
swap_red.description: Swap in use in percent at which pressure turns RED.

disk_amber_gb.title: Free disk amber (GB)
disk_amber_gb.description: Free space on / in GB at or below which pressure turns AMBER.

disk_red_gb.title: Free disk red (GB)
disk_red_gb.description: Free space on / in GB at or below which pressure turns RED.

load_amber_x.title: Load amber (x cores)
load_amber_x.description: 1-minute load average, as a multiple of the core count, at which pressure turns AMBER.

load_red_x.title: Load red (x cores)
load_red_x.description: 1-minute load average, as a multiple of the core count, at which pressure turns RED.

max_parallel_heavy.title: Parallel e2e and docker runs
max_parallel_heavy.description: How many e2e or docker runs may be active at once across all sessions. Further ones are refused.

extra_heavy_patterns.title: Extra heavy commands
extra_heavy_patterns.description: Extended regular expressions. A command whose executable and first words match is blocked under RED pressure, like an install or a build.
